attributes.name: card_accent_treatment
attributes.definition: Whether cards carry a thick colored edge accent on one side, and what it signals.

values.definition: Thick left border whose color encodes category or type.
Thick left border in one uniform brand/accent color.

attributes.name: card_text_alignment
attributes.definition: Alignment and arrangement of content within cards.

values.definition: Card content is centered, often with an icon above.
Card content is left-aligned and stacked vertically.

attributes.name: card_text_hierarchy
attributes.definition: How the typographic hierarchy within a card is built from label, title, and secondary lines.

values.definition: Bold name/title followed by smaller gray secondary line(s) such as role or location.
Small uppercase letter-spaced label sits above a bold item name.
Uppercase sans-serif title paired with serif descriptive text.
Bold dark name with a bold accent-colored price/value anchored at the card bottom.

attributes.name: card_icon_presence
attributes.definition: Whether cards lead with an icon.
